name: Sikafloor-01 Primer
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-01 PRIMER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-01 Primer, April 2023, Version 07.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sikafloor_-01_primer.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-01 Primer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 07.01).
1.2 Product description. Concentrated resin primer designed to be applied prior to cement & gypsum type products.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges. Sikafloor®-01 Primer;
    - Is suitable for pre-treating surfaces following the
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - recommended preparation & dilution rates.
    - Enhances bond strength between the substrate and subsequent Sika® materials
    - Can be used on internal or external applications
    - Is designed for commercial, residential & industrial installations
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-01 Primer
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SYNTHETIC RESIN PRIMER, APPLIED PRIOR TO FLOORING & TILING SYSTEMS
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability.
    - Green Star VOC-SCQMD Rule 1168
    - EPD according to ISO 14025 and EN 15804
    - Solvent-free according to TRGS 610
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 15804: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Sustainability (p.1).
    - ISO 14025: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Sustainability (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - • EMICODE EC 1PLUS certified ( Very Low VOC )
    - • BLUE ANGEL certified ( Eco frendly )
    - • Solvent-free
    - • Seals porous concrete
    - • Low consumption - high coverage
    - • Non-combustible
    - • Great penetration into porous concrete surfaces
    - • Can be applied neat over timber/wood, CFC & Scyon • Suitable for application on subfloor heating systems • Eliminates dust
    - • Versatile water dilution
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Synthetic resin
    - Appearance and colour: Blue
    - Density: 1L = 1kg
2.6 System structure.
    | Porous Concrete | Timber/wood/CFC/scyon |
    | Sikafloor®-01 Primer (diluted) | Sikafloor®-01 Primer (neat) |
    | Subsequent suitable materials | Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel |
    | Subsequent suitable materials |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5L plastic bottle
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production (in closed packaging)
2.8 Storage conditions. Approximately twelve (12) months from date of manufacture when stored in its unopened original container. Store in a cool, dry place. Do not store below +5 °C. Material that has been mixed with water should be used within a week.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 07.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Concrete should be fully cured, structurally sound with a minimum pull off strength of 1.5 MPa, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. Concrete must be porous and accept water penetration. Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with Sikafloor®-01 Primer can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present then loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed before installation. Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydro-static pressure. If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) Sikafloor®-158 W fast Barrier - moisture barrier system should be considered. Timber surfaces must be clean and freshly sanded to remove any previous coatings.
    - Contact your local Sika office for current system information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 07.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 1:3 ~ 7 - 8 m2 per mixed L; Average is depending on absorbency of the substrate, applicator device and mixing ratio.
    - Substrates: Internal/external concrete; Internal cement levelling compound/screed; Internal calcium sulphate based levelling compound; Internal timber & chipboard floors in raw form (no coatings)
4.3 Mixing ratio.
    | Substrate | Dilution & application |
    | Normal steel trowel concrete | 1L Sikafloor®-01 Primer : 3L water |
    | finish (porous) | x 1 coat  (broom or roller applied) |
    | Mechanically prepared concrete | 1L Sikafloor®-01 Primer : 3L water |
    | (very porous) | x 2 coats  (broom applied) |
    | Cement levelling compound/screed | 1L Sikafloor®-01 Primer : 3L water |
    | (very porous) | x 2 coats  (broom applied) |
    | Timber/wood/CFC/scyon | No dilution, apply neat |
    | x 1 coat (roller applied) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. Before appling Flooring/Tiling systems wait
    | Substrate | Waiting Time |
    | Normal absorbent substrates - | ~10 - 20 min @ 23 °C |
    | Concrete | Per coat |
    | Calcium sulphate based substrates, |
    | ~10 - 20 min @ 23 °C |
    | if calciumsulphate based levelling |
    | Per coat |
    | compounds are used |
    | Calcium sulphate based substrates, | ~24 hrs @ 23 °C |
    | if cement based levelling | Per coat |
    | compounds are used |
    | Timber and chipboards floors | ~2 hrs @ 23 °C |
    | Per coat |
    | Cement levelling substrate, if | ~1 hr @ 23 °C |
    | cement based levelling compounds | Per coat |
    | are used |
    | See above Mixing Ratio for dilution and coat recommendations. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    All values are approximate and subject to variation due to climatic conditions. Please refer also to the product datasheets of the cementitious levelling compounds and tile adhesives.
4.5 Mixing. Mix Sikafloor®-01 Primer at a ratio of 1:3 - 1:2 - 1:1 only with clean cool water.
4.6 Application. Apply diluted; Sikafloor®-01 Primer by way of a soft bristle broom, or long napped roller 10 – 15mm. Correct amount of mixed primer should always be applied to the prepared substrate, giving good penetration and film build. Thin applications may result in pinholing in finished surface or debonding levelling compound from the substrate. On particularly porous surfaces where the initial prime coat is absorbed immediately, or mechanically prepared surfaces a second coat is recommended. Avoid foam during application by adding more liquid. Apply neat; Sikafloor®-01 Primer over raw timber/chipboard, CFC & scyon with a long napped roller 10 – 15mm. Note: For best practice it is recommended subsequent construction materials are applied as soon as primer is dry, but no latter than 24hrs.
    - Do not allow primer to pool while drying as
    - Do not allow dust to settle on the surface.
    - If dust has contaminated the surface, first
    this will cause a soft spot under the cement compound.
    vacuum clean and apply another coat of primer before subsequent materials are installed.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not mix or apply Sikafloor®-01 Primer in
    - Sikafloor®-01 Primer is not recommended as a
    temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C.
    trafficable seal coat over cement based materials.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. between+5 °C to 35 °C
5.3 Substrate temperature. between +5 °C to 35 °C
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-01 Primer, April 2023, Version 07.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sikafloor_-01_primer.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
